text: Our corporate treasury at Indorama Synthetics transferred Rs 42 lakh after receiving an urgent email from our Managing Director's exact name asking to clear vendor dues before fiscal closing. The email originated from an external server with a domain typo.

A forged email requesting alteration of banking details for supplier Orient Electric was accepted by our junior accountant. Payment of Rs 18.5 lakh was sent to a fraudulent ICICI account in Kolkata instead of the authentic vendor account.

The accused has been sending sexually suggestive and threatening messages on my Instagram and Facebook for months. Even after filing a local police complaint and blocking 8 profiles, he creates new handles every few days with pictures of my workplace.
My phone was hacked and continuous threatening messages are received from unknown internet numbers stating they are tracking my whereabouts and monitoring who I speak to. I fear for my life.

Our diagnostic laboratory network was infected with LockBit ransomware. All patient records, MRI reports, and billing data are encrypted with .lockbit extension. The attackers demand 2.5 Bitcoin on a Tor payment portal.

I clicked an SMS link to download an e-challan payment application. The application installed background software that read all incoming SMS. Within minutes, two unauthorized transactions of Rs 65,000 were completed from my SBI account.

My Instagram profile with 45k followers was stolen after I clicked a link claiming copyright violation. The attacker changed email, phone number and password, and is now asking followers for urgent money in my name.
A scammer obtained my WhatsApp verification code by pretending to be a friend in an emergency. They logged into my account, set a 2FA PIN, and sent messages to all my contacts soliciting Rs 10,000.

I received an unknown WhatsApp video call where a woman stripped. They recorded my video and face. Within 5 minutes, they sent the recorded clip demanding Rs 30,000 via Google Pay, threatening to send it to my Facebook friend list.

I took a loan of Rs 5,000 from CashBean instant loan app. After repaying Rs 8,500, they are demanding another Rs 12,000 and sending morphed naked pictures with my face to my father and colleagues from my contact book.
My Axis Bank credit card was charged for Rs 85,000 on an international gambling website in Ireland while the card was physically in my possession in Pune. No OTP was triggered.

Someone used my stolen PAN and Aadhaar card copies to obtain 4 consumer durables loans worth Rs 1.8 lakh from Bajaj Finance. I only discovered this when recovery agents arrived at my ancestral address.

I ordered an air conditioner from a website electronicsbazaar-deals.in and transferred Rs 28,000 via UPI. The tracking number provided was fake and the customer support phone number is now disconnected.

I was promised a work from home job rating travel websites on Telegram. After small payouts, they asked me to deposit Rs 1.2 lakh in a merchant account to withdraw my earnings. Once deposited, they blocked me.
I invested Rs 6 lakh in a crypto trading scheme on Telegram promising 30% weekly returns. They showed fake profits on a website meta-trader-pro.cc but refused withdrawal demanding a 25% tax deposit.
